compiled_normal_log_switches.LIBUNWIND_PRINT_UNWINDING: Unwind cursor/compact and DWARF selection trace

enable_contract: Presence of the variable enables the cached flag, including string 0. Omit the variable to disable. Set uniformly from the first bootstrap for every process; do not set per trustd.
scope_limit: These switches enable their existing macros only; getInfoFromCompactEncodingSection has a separate const bool log=false that these flags do not override. No claim of every compact-table read being logged.
